    20→# Extract model name, version
    21→# model_id examples: claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-3-5
    22→model_name="Claude"
    23→model_version=""
    24→if echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "opus"; then

    27→elif echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "sonnet"; then

    30→elif echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "haiku"; then

    38→if [ -n "$model_id" ]; then

    47→model_label="${model_name}"

    50→# Append effort level only for non-Haiku models

    52→    effort=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // empty' /Users/admin/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null)
    53→    # Normalize effort: if empty, "default", or anything other than "high"/"low" -> "medium"
    54→    if [ "$effort" = "high" ]; then
    55→        effort_label="high"
    56→    elif [ "$effort" = "low" ]; then
    57→        effort_label="low"
    58→    else
    59→        effort_label="medium"
    60→    fi
    61→    model_label="${model_label} ${effort_label}"
    62→fi
    63→
    64→reset=$'\033[0m'
    65→dim_gray=$'\033[90m'
    66→bright_white=$'\033[97m'
    67→bright_yellow=$'\033[93m'
    68→bright_green=$'\033[92m'
    69→bright_red=$'\033[91m'
    70→bright_blue=$'\033[94m'
    71→bright_cyan=$'\033[96m'
    72→bold_red=$'\033[1;31m'
    73→
    74→# === Usage API (5h/7d rate limits) with file-based caching ===
    75→refresh_usage_cache() {
    76→    local now=$(date +%s)
    77→    local creds
    78→    creds=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s "Claude Code-credentials" -w 2>/dev/null)
    79→    [ -z "$creds" ] && return 1
    80→
    81→    local token
    82→    token=$(echo "$creds" | jq -r '.claudeAiOauth.accessToken // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    83→    [ -z "$token" ] && return 1
    84→
    85→    local response
    86→    response=$(curl -s --max-time 3 \
    87→        -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" \
    88→        -H "anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20" \
    89→        "https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage" 2>/dev/null)
    90→    [ -z "$response" ] && return 1
    91→
    92→    local five_hour seven_day
    93→    five_hour=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.five_hour.utilization // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    94→    seven_day=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.seven_day.utilization // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    95→    [ -z "$five_hour" ] && return 1
    96→
    97→    local five_hour_reset seven_day_reset
    98→    five_hour_reset=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.five_hour.resets_at // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    99→    seven_day_reset=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.seven_day.resets_at // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   100→
   101→    printf '{"timestamp":%d,"five_hour":%s,"seven_day":%s,"five_hour_reset":"%s","seven_day_reset":"%s"}\n' \
   102→        "$now" "$five_hour" "$seven_day" "$five_hour_reset" "$seven_day_reset" > "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE"
   103→}
   104→
   105→get_usage() {
   106→    local now=$(date +%s)
   107→    local need_refresh=1
   108→
   109→    if [ -f "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" ]; then
   110→        local cache_time
   111→        cache_time=$(jq -r '.timestamp // 0' "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
   112→        local age=$(( now - cache_time ))
   113→        [ "$age" -lt "$USAGE_CACHE_TTL" ] && need_refresh=0
   114→    fi
   115→
   116→    [ "$need_refresh" -eq 1 ] && refresh_usage_cache
   117→
   118→    if [ -f "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" ]; then
   119→        cat "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE"
   120→    else
   121→        echo '{}'
   122→    fi
   123→}
   124→
   125→usage_json=$(get_usage)
   126→five_hour=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.five_hour // "-"' 2>/dev/null)
   127→seven_day=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.seven_day // "-"' 2>/dev/null)
   128→five_hour_reset=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.five_hour_reset // ""' 2>/dev/null)
   129→seven_day_reset=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.seven_day_reset // ""' 2>/dev/null)
   130→
   131→# Format ISO 8601 reset time as absolute local time (e.g., "14:30", "3/9 14:30")
   132→format_reset_time() {
   133→    local reset_at=$1
   134→    [ -z "$reset_at" ] || [ "$reset_at" = "null" ] || [ "$reset_at" = "" ] && return
   135→
   136→    # Strip fractional seconds and timezone suffix, parse as UTC
   137→    local clean=$(echo "$reset_at" | sed -E 's/\.[0-9]+(Z|\+[0-9:]+)$//' | sed 's/Z$//' | sed 's/+00:00$//')
   138→    local reset_epoch=$(TZ=UTC date -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" "$clean" "+%s" 2>/dev/null)
   139→    [ -z "$reset_epoch" ] && return
   140→
   141→    local now=$(date +%s)
   142→    [ "$reset_epoch" -le "$now" ] && printf "now" && return
   143→
   144→    # Compare dates: if same day, show only HH:MM; otherwise show M/D HH:MM
   145→    local today=$(date +%Y%m%d)
   146→    local reset_day=$(date -r "$reset_epoch" +%Y%m%d)
   147→
   148→    if [ "$today" = "$reset_day" ]; then
   149→        date -r "$reset_epoch" "+%H:%M"
   150→    else
   151→        date -r "$reset_epoch" "+%-m/%-d %H:%M"
   152→    fi
   153→}
   154→
   155→# Build a colored progress bar for usage (same style as context bar)
   156→make_usage_bar() {
   157→    local label=$1
   158→    local val=$2
   159→    local reset_at=$3
   160→    local bw=10
   161→
   162→    local int_val=0
   163→    if [ "$val" != "-" ] && [ "$val" != "null" ]; then
   164→        int_val=$(printf "%.0f" "$val" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
   165→    fi
   166→
   167→    # Color based on usage
   168→    local bar_color
   169→    if [ "$int_val" -lt 50 ]; then
   170→        bar_color=$'\033[32m'  # Green
   171→    elif [ "$int_val" -lt 80 ]; then
   172→        bar_color=$'\033[33m'  # Yellow
   173→    else
   174→        bar_color=$'\033[31m'  # Red
   175→    fi
   176→
   177→    local f=$(( int_val * bw / 100 ))
   178→    [ "$f" -lt 0 ] && f=0
   179→    [ "$f" -gt "$bw" ] && f=$bw
   180→    local e=$(( bw - f ))
   181→
   182→    local bar_f="" bar_e=""
   183→    for ((i=0; i<f; i++)); do bar_f="${bar_f}█"; done
   184→    for ((i=0; i<e; i++)); do bar_e="${bar_e}░"; done
   185→
   186→    local reset_label=""
   187→    if [ -n "$reset_at" ] && [ "$reset_at" != "null" ]; then
   188→        local rt=$(format_reset_time "$reset_at")
   189→        [ -n "$rt" ] && reset_label=$(printf " ${bright_white}(%s)${reset}" "$rt")
   190→    fi
   191→
   192→    printf "${bright_white}%s${reset} ${bar_color}%s${dim_gray}%s${reset} ${bright_white}%d%%${reset}%s" \
   193→        "$label" "$bar_f" "$bar_e" "$int_val" "$reset_label"
   194→}
   195→
   196→five_hour_bar=$(make_usage_bar "5h" "$five_hour" "$five_hour_reset")
   197→seven_day_bar=$(make_usage_bar "7d" "$seven_day" "$seven_day_reset")
   198→
   199→# Get current folder name
   200→folder_name=$(basename "$cwd")
   201→
   202→# Get git branch and detect worktree
   203→cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME"
   204→git_branch=""
   205→is_worktree=0
   206→main_repo_name=""
   207→worktree_dir_name=""
   208→if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
   209→    git_branch=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "")
   210→
   211→    # Detect if current directory is a linked worktree
   212→    # Main worktree path is the first entry of `git worktree list`
   213→    main_wt_path=$(git worktree list 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
   214→    current_toplevel=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
   215→    if [ -n "$main_wt_path" ] && [ -n "$current_toplevel" ] && [ "$current_toplevel" != "$main_wt_path" ]; then
   216→        is_worktree=1
   217→        main_repo_name=$(basename "$main_wt_path")
   218→        worktree_dir_name=$(basename "$current_toplevel")
   219→    fi
   220→fi
   221→
   222→# Extract context window size and current input tokens
   223→ctx_window_size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 0')
   224→current_input=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // empty')
   225→
   226→# Format context window size (e.g., 200000 -> 200k, 1000000 -> 1m)
   227→format_ctx_size() {
   228→    local size=$1
   229→    if [ "$size" -ge 1000000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
   230→        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $size / 1000000" | bc)m"
   231→    elif [ "$size" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
   232→        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $size / 1000" | bc)k"
   233→    else
   234→        echo "${size}"
   235→    fi
   236→}
   237→
   238→# Format token count in k (e.g., 40000 -> 40k, 15500 -> 15k)
   239→format_tokens_k() {
   240→    local tokens=$1
   241→    if [ "$tokens" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
   242→        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $tokens / 1000" | bc)k"
   243→    else
   244→        echo "${tokens}"
   245→    fi
   246→}
   247→
   248→ctx_size_label=$(format_ctx_size "$ctx_window_size")
   249→
   250→# Build context usage label: "40k/200k" or "200k"
   251→if [ -n "$current_input" ] && [ "$current_input" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
   252→    used_label=$(format_tokens_k "$current_input")
   253→    ctx_usage_label="${used_label}/${ctx_size_label}"
   254→else
   255→    ctx_usage_label="${ctx_size_label}"
   256→fi
   257→
   258→# Create progress bar: filled blocks + empty blocks
   259→# Always show percentage; default to 0% when used_pct is absent (session start)
   260→bar_width=10
   261→used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "${used_pct:-0}" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
   262→filled=$(( used_int * bar_width / 100 ))
   263→[ "$filled" -lt 0 ] && filled=0
   264→[ "$filled" -gt "$bar_width" ] && filled=$bar_width
   265→empty_chars=$(( bar_width - filled ))
   266→
   267→# Color based on usage (green when 0% too)
   268→if [ "$used_int" -lt 50 ]; then
   269→    ctx_color=$'\033[32m'  # Green
   270→elif [ "$used_int" -lt 75 ]; then
   271→    ctx_color=$'\033[33m'  # Yellow
   272→else
   273→    ctx_color=$'\033[31m'  # Red
   274→fi
   275→
   276→bar_filled=""
   277→bar_empty=""
   278→for ((i=0; i<filled; i++)); do bar_filled="${bar_filled}█"; done
   279→for ((i=0; i<empty_chars; i++)); do bar_empty="${bar_empty}░"; done
   280→
   281→progress_bar=$(printf "${bright_white}Context${reset} ${ctx_color}%s${dim_gray}%s${reset} ${bright_white}${used_int}%%${reset} | ${bright_white}%s${reset}" "$bar_filled" "$bar_empty" "$ctx_usage_label")
   282→
   283→# Line 1: Robot icon + Model | Progress bar | context usage
   284→# U+1F916 ROBOT FACE in UTF-8: F0 9F A4 96
   285→robot=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\xA4\x96')
   286→line1=$(printf "%s ${model_color}%s${reset} | %s" "$robot" "$model_label" "$progress_bar")
   287→
   288→# Icons for line 2
   289→# U+1F4C1 OPEN FILE FOLDER in UTF-8: F0 9F 93 81
   290→icon_dir=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\x93\x81')
   291→# U+E0A0 POWERLINE BRANCH SYMBOL in UTF-8: EE 82 A0
   292→icon_branch=$(printf '\xEE\x82\xA0')
   293→# U+1F33F HERB (worktree) in UTF-8: F0 9F 8C BF
   294→icon_worktree=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\x8C\xBF')
   295→
   296→# Line 2: Directory | Git branch
   297→# If in a linked worktree: show "📁 main-repo | 🌿 worktree-dir"
   298→# Otherwise: show "📁 current-dir"
   299→if [ "$is_worktree" -eq 1 ]; then
   300→    line2=$(printf "%s ${bright_yellow}%s${reset} | %s ${bright_green}%s${reset}" "$icon_dir" "$main_repo_name" "$icon_worktree" "$worktree_dir_name")
   301→else
   302→    line2=$(printf "%s ${bright_yellow}%s${reset}" "$icon_dir" "$folder_name")
   303→fi
   304→if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then
   305→    # Color branch by type
   306→    branch_color="$bright_white"
   307→    if [ "$git_branch" = "master" ] || [ "$git_branch" = "main" ]; then
   308→        branch_color="$bright_red"
   309→    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^develop"; then
   310→        branch_color="$bright_blue"
   311→    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^feat" || echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^feature"; then
   312→        branch_color="$bright_cyan"
   313→    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^release"; then
   314→        branch_color="$bright_yellow"
   315→    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^hotfix"; then
   316→        branch_color="$bold_red"
   317→    elif [ "$is_worktree" -eq 1 ]; then
   318→        branch_color="$bright_green"
   319→    fi
   320→    line2=$(printf "%s | %s ${branch_color}%s${reset}" "$line2" "$icon_branch" "$git_branch")
   321→
   322→    # Git file change stats (added/modified/deleted)
   323→    git_status=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)
   324→    if [ -n "$git_status" ]; then
   325→        added=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^??\|^A \|^A[MD]')
   326→        modified=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^ M\|^M \|^MM\|^AM\|^R ')
   327→        deleted=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^ D\|^D \|^MD')
   328→
   329→        git_changes=""
   330→        [ "$added" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_green}+${added}${reset}"
   331→        [ "$modified" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_yellow}~${modified}${reset}"
   332→        [ "$deleted" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_red}-${deleted}${reset}"
   333→        [ -n "$git_changes" ] && line2=$(printf "%s |%s" "$line2" "$git_changes")
   334→    fi
   335→fi
   336→
   337→# Append usage bars to line 1
   338→line1=$(printf "%s | ${bright_white}Usage${reset} %s | %s" "$line1" "$five_hour_bar" "$seven_day_bar")
   339→
   340→# Output both lines
   341→printf "%s\n%s" "$line1" "$line2"
   342→
